exact_diagnostics.status: DONE — ten exact elementary diagnostic families

families.name: Raw homogeneous FS is not automatically USC
families.scope: Published Example 2.21; rational Gauss weights tending to infinity approach the supported point. A downward raw jump does not refute a canonical regularized psh correspondence.

families.name: Canonical Veronese approximants retain original weights
families.scope: Definition 1.12 uses unrescaled restriction to R_d. Example 2.21 printed simple-vanishing value 1 is native rescaling; the original value is d. Its nonuniform approximation conclusion remains correct.

families.name: Native Veronese barycenter and original-degree barycenter
families.scope: Restriction of weights alone does not preserve a volume divided by native degree. The source direct-limit convention retains original degree.

families.name: Probability Monge–Ampere intersection normalization
families.scope: The printed ordinary-intersection sum on p. 881 needs division by (L^n), as confirmed by MA(0)=delta_triv and energy formula (4.4).

families.name: Okounkov value lattice for a non-birational subalgebra
families.scope: S=k[x^2,y^2] has ambient body [0,1] but even-degree Hilbert coefficient tending to 1/2. The printed body-volume and interior lattice equalities need the value-lattice/degree support convention. This example does not refute the intended approximation limit.

families.name: Valuation and plus-sign Legendre coordinates
families.scope: For v_xi(T)=xi and the source plus-sign Legendre transform, section evaluation gives g-vee(-xi)-0-vee(-xi). The printed toric FS and real-MA identification need reflection; the positive gradient pushforward is consistent with the valuation coordinate.

families.name: Redundant higher-rank product action

evidence.configuration: X times A^r, pullback L, torus acting only on A^r

families.scope: Definition A.14 permits this product for any positive rationally independent direction. Proposition A.15 exact-rank assertion needs effectiveness/minimality; finite-type existence and rank at most r survive.

families.name: Ordered rooftop estimate and constants
families.scope: Theorem 5.8 pointwise estimate is a direct formal inequality; it does not clear imported locality, domination or finite-energy continuity.

families.name: Integer rounding and degree-zero translation
families.scope: Floor error is below one before degree normalization; degree-zero unit cannot be moved by adding c*m. No uniform-in-all-ray-time approximation is asserted.

families.name: Signed mean versus L1 and constant quotient
families.scope: Ordered energy differences, unordered L1 distance and quotient by constants are three distinct operations.
